# Madrid, BNE MSS/8387 (Cartas ... a Diego José Dormer, vol. VI), inserted slip wholly in cipher, fol. 190r-v = views 196 (recto) and 197 (verso).
# Held-out set H: transcribed on 5 Nov 2026 before any key trial and hashed (SHA-256 68d7d2e9...); never decoded before the measurement.
# Transcribed from the BNE Digital images (120 ppi; not reproduced here). 974 cipher signs.
# Conventions: signs separated by "."; manuscript punctuation (; : ,) kept; "?" = illegible sign; "…" = line end hidden in the binding (verso, view 197);
# "#n" = a number written between "=" (a sum, outside the alphabet); "|…|" = signs between bars (a gloss "mi" above them, NOT used);
# "[n.n]" = interlinear insertion read in place. Label "7" = the sign shaped like ")", "17" = "1)": the labels are sign names, read as numbers.
# Line ids: v<view>.<line>. View = rank of the image in the BNE digitisation (two PDF halves, 1-134 and 135-269), not the folio.
